rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person acts according to changing moods.

example.english: I acted temperamentally toward people, then acted as if nothing had happened.
example.traditional: 我情緒化咁對人，轉頭又扮冇事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cing4 seoi5 faa3 gam3 deoi3 jan4 zyun2 tau4 jau6 baan6 mou5 si6

rows.note: Use this when a machine, system, or situation behaves unpredictably, alternating between working and failing.

example.english: The air conditioner behaves temperamentally, blowing air one moment and not the next.
example.traditional: 部冷氣忽好忽壞咁，一陣有風一陣冇風。
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 fat1 hou2 fat1 waai6 gam3 jat1 zan6 jau5 fung1 jat1 zan6 mou5 fung1
